title: Build Your Resume from Scratch - Resume Builder - The Basics
description:
LIKE & SUBSCRIBE for you more Resume, Job Search & Career Growth content!

Ready to dive into the world of resume building?  Whether you're starting from scratch or looking to enhance your existing resume, this video guides you through the process of creating a professional resume that stands out! 

What We Will Cover:
- How to build a resume from scratch 
- Editing your contact information 
- Adding a target title 
- Crafting a professional summary 
- Inputting work experience 
- Creating bullet points for job descriptions 
- Adding education, certifications, awards, and scholarships 
- Listing your skills and interests 

Questions Answered in This Video:
- How do I start building a resume if I have no existing information?
- What steps do I take to add my work experience?
- How can I create a professional summary?
- How do I list my skills and interests effectively?
